Are you an engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and discovering why products sometimes fail? Do you like combining analytical thinking with hands-on troubleshooting? Then this could be your next challenge. For an innovative technology company in the Eindhoven region, we are looking for a PCB & Electronics Engineer. In this role, you investigate technical issues in advanced electronic and mechatronic products and turn your findings into concrete improvements. You will work at the intersection of engineering, quality and production. Your analysis will not only help solve individual failures, but also contribute to making future products more reliable. What will you do? As a PCB & Electronics Engineer you investigate products that show unexpected behaviour or have failed during production or after being used by customers. You work methodically to determine what went wrong and, more importantly, why. Your responsibilities include: Investigating technical failures in electronic and mechatronic products and identifying their underlying causes. Performing structured failure investigations and translating technical findings into clear conclusions. Testing, measuring and troubleshooting products and components using a hands-on approach. Working closely with engineers, production and quality specialists to solve recurring technical issues. Supporting the implementation of short-term solutions to prevent defective products from entering the production process. Identifying opportunities to improve product reliability, production processes and future designs. Documenting your investigations and communicating your findings clearly to the relevant stakeholders. Contributing to continuous improvement projects across the organization. The role offers a combination of engineering, analysis and practical troubleshooting. You won't spend your entire day behind a desk: you will regularly work directly with the products and equipment you are investigating. What can yo

 Job description 
As a Condition Monitoring Specialist, you are independently engaged daily in various measurements and inspections of rotating equipment, on location at our customers. Here you can think of electric motors, fans, pumps, generators and gearboxes. You will use your expertise in combination with modern measurement and inspection techniques to advise our customers on preventing and also solving machine problems. This makes you the face of our organization! You then process the results of your measurements and analyses in reports, so that both you and the customer always have insight into all processes. 
Our customers are large industrial and maritime organizations throughout the Netherlands and Belgium. To perform your work to perfection, we provide you with a well-equipped van with all the necessary tools and resources. It is important that Condition Monitoring is in your blood and that you can handle the independence that this position entails. 
 What are you bringing? 
You are curious and find it interesting to work in various locations. With your interest in technology, you are always willing to learn new things. In this position you are alternately working with your hands and behind the computer. 
Furthermore, you have; 
- A technical education at MBO level; 
- Knowledge and experience with maintenance, inspection, diagnostic and measurement techniques; 
- A good command of the Dutch and English language.
